_README: FIX-J (2026-06-10): allowlist of type:object schema nodes that INTENTIONALLY omit `additionalProperties` and are therefore exempt from tests/schemas/test_nested_additional_properties.py. Every other type:object node MUST declare additionalProperties (set to false during FIX-J). Each entry: schema filename -> JSON-pointer -> one-line justification. Adding an entry is a deliberate decision (a node that must stay open); the test also fails if an allowlisted node no longer exists or is no longer open (keeps this file honest).

dataforseo-endpoint-mapping.schema.json.#/definitions/inputField/properties/item: Polymorphic JSON-Schema-fragment descriptor: holds an arbitrary item-type sub-schema (e.g. {"type":"object"}); closing it would forbid the very type/format/items keys it exists to carry. Mirrors gsc/sf-mcp inputField shape (cross-MCP symmetry).

gsc-tool-mapping.schema.json.#/definitions/inputField/properties/item: Polymorphic JSON-Schema-fragment descriptor (same node as dataforseo/sf-mcp inputField.items); inherently open — closing forbids the item-type keys it carries.

sf-mcp-tool-mapping.schema.json.#/definitions/inputField/properties/item: Polymorphic JSON-Schema-fragment descriptor; live engine instance templates/sf-mcp/use-case-example.json puts {"type":"object"} here (url_list.items), so closing would reject a real instance.
